dimensions.evidenceA: Saul knows David as a favored servant and sends to Jesse.
dimensions.evidenceB: Saul asks for the youth’s family identity.
dimensions.label: Prior knowledge

evidence.observation: David comes to Saul, is greatly loved, becomes his armor bearer, and receives favor.
Saul asks Abner and then David whose son the young man is.

record.tension: Saul’s earlier relationship with David stands beside his later question about David’s father.
record.title: Does Saul recognize David?
